name: Slouch from the Dead: The Musical
description: A grand theatre stages the fall of Slouch HQ: red velvet and gold, a ruined glass tower under a storm, its giant hexagonal-hashtag sign smashed into the facade, hashtag zombies (typogrombies) crawling all over the building, and a five-scene musical on the stage: tap NEXT to change the set and tap the cast to hear them sing.

spots.label: Pam, the project manager
spots.say: ♪ Good morning, team! Yesterday, today, and any blockers? Keep it under fifteen minutes, and nobody touch the donuts until we're done! ♪

spots.label: Gary from Backend
spots.say: ♪ Yesterday: braaains. Today: braaains. Blockers: nobody brought any braaains. ♪

spots.label: #standup, the channel
spots.say: ♪ I used to be a meeting. Now I'm a channel. I crawl from calendar to calendar. ♪

spots.label: Ivy, the intern
spots.say: ♪ I only meant to send it to my mom! Now three thousand people know my lasagna recipe! ♪

spots.label: Doreen from HR
spots.say: Per my last email... and the email before that... and the one before that...

spots.label: The coffee machine
spots.say: ♪ Out of beans! Out of filters! Out of patience! Please descale me! ♪

spots.label: Dale from IT
spots.say: ♪ Have you tried turning it off and on again? I did. Now I'm like this. ♪

spots.label: The typing indicator
spots.say: Someone is typing... someone is typing... someone has been typing since Tuesday.

spots.label: Chet, the CEO
spots.say: ♪ We're not a company, we're a family! An undead family with excellent dental! ♪

spots.label: The letter O
spots.say: Don't mind me. I'm just hanging around.

spots.label: A crow
spots.say: Caw. That means synergy, in crow.

spots.label: The chorus
spots.say: ♪ Huddle up! Huddle up! Cameras off and mics on mute! Slouch from the Dead, eight shows a week! ♪

spots.label: Pam, the project manager
spots.say: ♪ Same time next week, everyone! I'll send an invite! ♪
